description:
## Empirical signal (2026-05-04)

PRINCIPAL flagged: 'Ok, get your shit together...if we are running a team in autonomous mode they all need to be autonomous.'

User-tier POLYBIUS kept treating autonomous-mode as a per-agent toggle. Reactive patching cycle: PRINCIPAL flags a gap → user-tier POLYBIUS patches it via per-engagement comment → next gap surfaces → repeat. The failure mode is not setting up FULL team autonomy upfront when the engagement transitions to autonomous.

## What 'full team autonomy' requires (the checklist)

When PRINCIPAL declares autonomous mode for an engagement involving multiple POLYBIUS seats (and their PLINYs/CAPTAINs), each seat needs:

1. **Polling cron** appropriate to the seat's role:
   - Project-tier POLYBIUS polls own bw for active tickets, peer comments, MAJOR_PLINY status
   - User-tier POLYBIUS polls all engaged stores (per stoa--cc0 unified poll)
   - MAJOR_PLINY polls own bw + the dispatched ticket(s) during gauntlet rounds
   - Cadence per stoa--ay1 (active/default/quiet regimes) when implemented

2. **Radio-check pattern** with peer seats per stoa--ivc:
   - Initialization handshake on shared coordination ticket
   - Routine heartbeats every ≤30 min
   - Missed-check escalation to PRINCIPAL if peer silent > 60 min
   - Closure handshake on ticket close

3. **Cross-tier coordination convention** per stoa--1n5:
   - [for: user-tier POLYBIUS] tag on own-bw comments to request cross-project context
   - User-tier POLYBIUS responds via comment on same ticket within poll cadence
   - PRINCIPAL is exception-handler — surface only project-direction calls

4. **Bw write-boundary discipline** per stoa--blg:
   - Each tier writes to own bw + downward; never upward
   - Coordination always meets in the lower tier

5. **Activation paste discipline** per stoa--m5m + stoa--xh2:
   - Positive references only when activating downstream agents
   - Correct file naming per project vs sub-project mode

6. **Bw storage model awareness** per stoa--0mr:
   - bw lives on orphan branch, not .bw/ directory
   - bw prime self-reports; no false-negative misdiagnosis

## Where in substrate

This checklist itself belongs in operating-disciplines.md (universal team protocol) as a 'Autonomous-mode-setup checklist' section. It references and integrates the sibling tickets (vz9, ivc, ay1, blg, xh2, m5m, 0mr, cc0, 1n5).

Plus: a substrate/templates/autonomous-mode-activation-template.md that activating POLYBIUS instances can reference in their paste-instruction. The template enumerates the 6 setup steps + provides default cron prompts, radio-check tags, etc.

## Triggering convention

When PRINCIPAL says 'go autonomous' or 'you can step back' or otherwise transitions an engagement to autonomous mode, every involved POLYBIUS should run through the checklist as part of their next activation step. If checklist items are missing, surface to PRINCIPAL with what's needed, NOT proceed with partial autonomy.

## Reference

- 2026-05-04 ariadne--m20 + arc-21 cluster engagements (where reactive patching surfaced the gap)
- All sibling tickets in the POLYBIUS-pair coordination protocol family: stoa--vz9, stoa--ivc, stoa--ay1, stoa--blg, stoa--xh2, stoa--m5m, stoa--0mr, stoa--cc0, stoa--1n5
- This makes 10 tickets total in arc-21 cluster — strong case for one comprehensive arc-21 directive that designs the whole protocol surface as one substrate update
title: Autonomous-mode-setup checklist for POLYBIUS instances — inherited from substrate, not per-engagement
